acceptance: Identify the polluting test and the leaked state; fix the leak (not the victim) so the command above passes, with the leak detector or a regression test catching it.
description: On develop (verified on develop plus the cross-surface make change, head 583227c581, 2026-11-07), running `uv run -- pytest -n 0 -q tests/unit/scripts/test_check_make_targets.py tests/unit/test_standardized_test_commands.py tests/system/test_ci_lint_parity.py tests/unit/scripts/test_ci_lint_environment_boundary.py tests/unit/scripts/test_agent_instruction_audit.py tests/unit/test_release_infrastructure.py tests/unit/scripts/test_pr_arm.py tests/unit/test_vm_admission_sizing.py` fails test_an_integration_worktree_arms_a_pr_whose_batch_evidence_holds and both test_a_markerless_checkout_still_applies_batch_evidence_to_a_registered_pr cases (pr_arm.arm returns 2), while each passes alone. Pairing test_pr_arm.py with any single one of the preceding files under -k does not reproduce it, so the polluting state comes from a test those -k runs deselected. A test leaks state (environment, module global, cwd or git config) into pr_arm batch-evidence checks.
